name: Problem-Centred Institutional Memory
summary: Reconstruct scattered work as stable problems, dated attempts, qualified outcomes and reusable solutions while preserving source coverage and contradictory evidence.
problem: Repeated recaps lose failed attempts, merge unrelated work and promote remembered completion into unsupported institutional knowledge.
coreOutcomes: Stable problem and source identities across conversations
A resumable retrieval queue with explicit coverage gaps
requirements: Authorised conversation excerpts, exports or handover records
Existing canonical index and its schema when available
Dates, context identities and source locators
A publication boundary for private history
boundaries: Search results and summaries are not complete transcripts
Historical requests do not become fresh execution authority
